name: Exact sanctions or watchlist match
title: Exact sanctions / watchlist match
explanationTemplate: Exact match on {attributes.listName} for {attributes.matchedName}.

name: Potential sanctions match needs review
title: Potential sanctions match
explanationTemplate: Possible (name-based) match on {attributes.listName} for {attributes.matchedName}. Needs manual disposition to rule out a false positive.

name: Federal exclusion hit for a healthcare role
title: Federal exclusion hit for a healthcare role
explanationTemplate: Exact match on {attributes.listName} for a healthcare role. Excluded individuals generally cannot be employed in federally funded healthcare.

name: Sex offender registry match
title: Sex offender registry match
explanationTemplate: Registry match in {attributes.registryState}, tier {attributes.tier}.

name: Possible sex offender registry match
title: Possible sex offender registry match
explanationTemplate: Partial (name or date of birth) match in {attributes.registryState}. Needs manual review; escalated for child-facing roles.

name: Identity invalid or synthetic
title: Identity could not be validated
explanationTemplate: SSN trace flagged: valid={attributes.ssnValid}, deceased={attributes.deceasedFlag}, issuedBeforeDob={attributes.ssnIssuedBeforeDob}, multipleIdentities={attributes.multipleIdentitiesFlag}.

name: Name or date of birth mismatch
title: Identity details do not match
explanationTemplate: Candidate-supplied details differ from the source: nameMatch={attributes.nameMatch}, dobMatch={attributes.dobMatch}.

name: Felony conviction within lookback period
title: Felony conviction on record
explanationTemplate: {attributes.offenceCategory} felony, offence date {attributes.offenceDate}, within the {param.criminalLookbackYears}-year lookback.

name: Record found that the candidate did not disclose
title: Undisclosed criminal record
explanationTemplate: A {attributes.severity} record ({attributes.offenceCategory}, {attributes.jurisdictionState}) was found but the candidate did not disclose it.

name: Misdemeanor within lookback, or pending case
title: Misdemeanor or pending criminal case
explanationTemplate: {attributes.severity} ({attributes.offenceCategory}), disposition {attributes.disposition}, {attributes.yearsSinceOffence} years ago. Escalated when the offence is relevant to a finance or child-facing role.

name: Older conviction or dismissed case
title: Older conviction or dismissed case
explanationTemplate: Disposition {attributes.disposition}, {attributes.yearsSinceOffence} years since the offence (lookback {param.criminalLookbackYears} years).

name: Positive or refused drug test on a safety-sensitive or driving role
title: Failed or refused drug test (safety-sensitive role)
explanationTemplate: Drug test result {attributes.result}, MRO status {attributes.mroStatus}, for a safety-sensitive or driving role.

name: Dilute result or MRO review pending
title: Dilute drug test or MRO review pending
explanationTemplate: Result {attributes.result}, MRO status {attributes.mroStatus}.

name: Positive or refused drug test (other roles)
title: Failed or refused drug test
explanationTemplate: Drug test result {attributes.result}, MRO status {attributes.mroStatus}.

name: Recent DUI or suspended licence on a driving role
title: DUI or licence suspension (driving role)
explanationTemplate: {attributes.duiCount} DUI(s), last one {attributes.yearsSinceLastDui} years ago; licence status {attributes.licenceStatus}.

name: High points or repeated moving violations
title: Driving record points or violations above threshold
explanationTemplate: {attributes.totalPoints} points (limit {param.mvrMaxPoints}); {attributes.violationsLast3y} moving violations in the last 3 years.

name: Licence class does not match the role
title: Licence class mismatch for a driving role
explanationTemplate: Candidate holds class {attributes.licenceClass}, which does not meet the requirement of the role.

name: E-Verify final non-confirmation or expired authorization
title: Work authorization not confirmed or expired
explanationTemplate: E-Verify status {attributes.everifyStatus}; authorization status {attributes.authStatus}.

name: E-Verify tentative non-confirmation or authorization expiring soon
title: Work authorization needs follow-up
explanationTemplate: E-Verify status {attributes.everifyStatus}; {attributes.daysToExpiry} days until authorization expires.

name: Fake or shell employer
title: Employer appears fake or a shell company
explanationTemplate: The declared employer could not be validated as a real business.

name: Ineligible for rehire or terminated for cause
title: Previous employer would not rehire / terminated for cause
explanationTemplate: Rehire eligible: {attributes.rehireEligible}; terminated for cause: {attributes.terminatedForCause}.

name: Title inflation or large tenure discrepancy
title: Employment details differ from what was declared
explanationTemplate: Title matches: {attributes.titleMatch}; tenure differs by {attributes.tenureDiffDays} days.

name: Employment gap above threshold
title: Unexplained employment gap
explanationTemplate: Longest gap is {attributes.longestGapMonths} months (threshold {param.employmentGapMonths}).

name: Minor tenure discrepancy
title: Minor tenure discrepancy
explanationTemplate: Employment dates differ from the declared dates by {attributes.tenureDiffDays} days.

name: Employer could not be reached
title: Employer could not be contacted
explanationTemplate: The employer was unreachable or refused to verify, so the claim is unconfirmed.

name: Diploma mill, unaccredited institution or degree not conferred
title: Education credential not valid
explanationTemplate: Diploma mill: {attributes.diplomaMillFlag}; accredited: {attributes.accredited}; degree conferred: {attributes.conferred}.

name: Large date mismatch or unverifiable institution
title: Education details could not be fully confirmed
explanationTemplate: Graduation date differs by {attributes.graduationDateDiffDays} days; institution verifiable: {attributes.institutionVerifiable}.

name: Minor graduation date discrepancy
title: Minor education date discrepancy
explanationTemplate: Graduation date differs by {attributes.graduationDateDiffDays} days.

name: Instant vs manual employment verification conflict
title: Instant and manual employment data conflict
explanationTemplate: Payroll-network data from {attributes.payrollProvider} conflicts with manual verification on: {attributes.discrepancyFields}.

name: Licence revoked or suspended
title: Professional licence revoked or suspended
explanationTemplate: {attributes.licenceType} licence from {attributes.issuingBody} is {attributes.licenceStatus}.

name: Licence expiring soon or restricted
title: Licence expiring soon or has restrictions
explanationTemplate: {attributes.daysToExpiry} days until expiry; restrictions present: {attributes.hasRestrictions}.

name: Licence expired
title: Professional licence expired
explanationTemplate: {attributes.licenceType} licence from {attributes.issuingBody} has expired.

name: Negative reference
title: Negative reference
explanationTemplate: Negative remarks: {attributes.hasNegativeRemarks}; rehire recommendation: {attributes.rehireRecommendation}.

name: Reference unreachable or declined
title: Reference could not be obtained
explanationTemplate: The reference was unreachable or declined to answer. This is not an adverse finding on its own.

name: Multiple contradicted resume claims
title: Resume contradicted by verified data
explanationTemplate: {attributes.claimsContradicted} of {attributes.claimsTotal} resume claims were contradicted by verification.

name: Unverifiable resume claims
title: Some resume claims could not be verified
explanationTemplate: {attributes.claimsUnverifiable} resume claim(s) could not be verified.

name: Identity mismatch plus another discrepancy
title: Possible impersonation or identity mix-up
explanationTemplate: An identity mismatch appears together with another discrepancy (employment: {EMPLOYMENT.result}, education: {EDUCATION.result}, criminal: {CRIMINAL.result}).

name: Discrepancies across employment, education and licence
title: Possible fabrication pattern
explanationTemplate: At least two of employment, education and licence verification show discrepancies, which can indicate a pattern of inflated claims.

name: Employment gap overlaps a conviction
title: Employment gap overlaps a conviction
explanationTemplate: An employment gap coincides with the period of a conviction or sentence.

name: Licence expired but employer confirms practice
title: Practised with an expired licence
explanationTemplate: The licence is expired, but the previous employer confirms the candidate was practising in that role.

name: Verification overdue
title: Verification is overdue
explanationTemplate: {searchType} has been pending {meta.hoursPending}h against an expected {meta.slaHours}h turnaround.

name: Start date at risk
title: Start date at risk: checks still incomplete
explanationTemplate: {order.pendingCount} check(s) are still incomplete and the start date is {order.daysToStart} day(s) away (buffer {param.startBufferDays} days).

name: Expected checks were not ordered
title: Expected checks were not ordered
explanationTemplate: {order.notOrderedCount} search(es) expected for this job were not ordered, so the report has coverage gaps.

name: Search could not be verified
title: Verification could not be completed
explanationTemplate: {searchType} could not be verified, so the related claims remain unconfirmed.

name: Low match confidence
title: Low-confidence match
explanationTemplate: {searchType} match confidence is {matchConfidence} (minimum {param.minMatchConfidence}); the record may belong to a different person or be missed.

name: Stale verification result
title: Verification result is stale
explanationTemplate: {searchType} was completed {meta.reportAgeDays} days ago (maximum {param.maxReportAgeDays} days). Consider refreshing it before the start date.

name: Source retries or failures
title: Verification source keeps failing
explanationTemplate: {searchType} has been retried {meta.retryCount} times without success (last error: {meta.errorCode}).
